statements.statement: Residential plumbing and heating firm with 6 engineers and 2 office staff, mostly boiler servicing, repairs and bathroom refits
Priority for the next year is more planned servicing contracts and fewer one-off emergency call-outs
Calls during jobs or after 5pm go to voicemail and some are never returned
statements.impact: Customer believes some new jobs go to competitors
statements.staff_time: about 1 hour a day listening to and returning voicemails
statements.workaround: Engineers sometimes take calls on their own mobiles

statements.statement: Website form enquiries arrive in the shared inbox and can wait a day for a reply
statements.errors_rework: Occasionally two people reply to the same enquiry

statements.statement: Quotes for refits are typed up in a word processor from the engineer's site notes
statements.errors_rework: Prices sometimes copied from an out-of-date price list
statements.workaround: Owner re-checks large quotes before they are sent

statements.statement: Nobody follows up quotes that get no response
statements.impact: Customer does not know how many quotes are lost this way

statements.statement: Engineers' diaries are juggled by phone when an emergency job comes in
statements.errors_rework: Double bookings happen about twice a month
statements.workaround: A paper whiteboard in the office mirrors the calendar

statements.statement: Jobs are tracked in a shared spreadsheet, invoices in Xero, bookings in a shared Google Calendar
Calls go to a single office landline with a basic voicemail; email is a shared Gmail inbox
Completed jobs are re-keyed from the spreadsheet into Xero to raise invoices
statements.errors_rework: Missed or duplicated invoices found at month end

statements.statement: Annual service reminders are sent by hand from a list
Xero sends automatic payment reminders; nothing else is automated and no AI tools are used
Month-end invoicing is the biggest bottleneck and delays cash coming in
statements.impact: Payment typically arrives 3-4 weeks after the job

statements.statement: The office laptop holding the job spreadsheet has no backup
statements.workaround: Owner occasionally copies it to a USB stick

statements.statement: Customer details exist separately in the spreadsheet, Xero and the phone contacts, and often disagree
statements.errors_rework: Invoices sent to old addresses a few times a quarter
statements.cost: Owner estimates one or two unpaid invoices a quarter, around 300 GBP each

statements.statement: Owner would most like enquiries and bookings to run without the office chasing them
Quotes and any message about price must be approved by the owner before sending
Budget is limited this year and the team wants to keep Xero
statements.cost: Owner mentioned up to 150 GBP a month for new software
